body:
name: answer-feedback-browser

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - index.html
      - styles.css
      - src/knowledge.mjs
      - src/review.mjs
      - src/reflections.mjs
      - src/deck.mjs
      - src/deck-picker.mjs
      - src/session-export.mjs
      - src/trace-archive.mjs
      - src/trace-archive-ui.mjs
      - src/lesson-archive.mjs
      - src/lesson-archive-ui.mjs
      - src/answer-order.mjs
      - src/app.mjs
      - data/deck.json
      - demo.html
      - tools/make_demo.py
      - docs/receiving/answer-feedback-ab529ac65023/literal-deck.json
      - tools/check_answer_feedback_browser.mjs
      - .github/workflows/answer-feedback-browser.yml
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - index.html
      - styles.css
      - src/knowledge.mjs
      - src/review.mjs
      - src/reflections.mjs
      - src/deck.mjs
      - src/deck-picker.mjs
      - src/session-export.mjs
      - src/trace-archive.mjs
      - src/trace-archive-ui.mjs
      - src/lesson-archive.mjs
      - src/lesson-archive-ui.mjs
      - src/answer-order.mjs
      - src/app.mjs
      - data/deck.json
      - demo.html
      - tools/make_demo.py
      - docs/receiving/answer-feedback-ab529ac65023/literal-deck.json
      - tools/check_answer_feedback_browser.mjs
      - .github/workflows/answer-feedback-browser.yml

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  real-browser:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      # Keep the existing workflows intact and use their pinned action identities.
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"
      - name: Check maintained receiver syntax
        run: node --check tools/check_answer_feedback_browser.mjs
      - name: Verify the committed standalone learner
        run: |
          python3 tools/make_demo.py
          git diff --exit-code -- demo.html
      - name: Receive visible answer identities with installed Chrome
        run: |
          chrome_bin="$(command -v google-chrome)"
          "$chrome_bin" --version
          node tools/check_answer_feedback_browser.mjs --root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --browser "$chrome_bin" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/answer-feedback-receiving" --emit-bundle

name: course-handout-browser

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'handout/**'
      - 'handout.html'
      - 'src/course-handout*.mjs'
      - 'src/deck.mjs'
      - 'author/**'
      - 'author.html'
      - 'src/deck-author*.mjs'
      - 'tools/make_handout.py'
      - 'tools/make_author.py'
      - 'tools/check_course_handout_browser.mjs'
      - 'docs/receiving/course-handout-7879c2abc07f/fixture.json'
      - '.github/workflows/course-handout-browser.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'handout/**'
      - 'handout.html'
      - 'src/course-handout*.mjs'
      - 'src/deck.mjs'
      - 'author/**'
      - 'author.html'
      - 'src/deck-author*.mjs'
      - 'tools/make_handout.py'
      - 'tools/make_author.py'
      - 'tools/check_course_handout_browser.mjs'
      - 'docs/receiving/course-handout-7879c2abc07f/fixture.json'
      - '.github/workflows/course-handout-browser.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  receive-handout:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 8
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4, inherited project pin
      - name: Require cached Node 22 and an installed system browser
        id: native
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          HANDOUT_NODE_VERSION=
          for HANDOUT_NODE_DIR in "${RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE}/node"/22.*; do
            if [[ -x "${HANDOUT_NODE_DIR}/x64/bin/node" && -f "${HANDOUT_NODE_DIR}/x64.complete" ]]; then
              HANDOUT_NODE_VERSION="${HANDOUT_NODE_DIR##*/}"
            fi
          done
          [[ -n "${HANDOUT_NODE_VERSION}" ]] || { echo "A complete cached Node 22 is required; no runtime will be installed."; exit 1; }
          printf 'node=%s\n' "${HANDOUT_NODE_VERSION}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          HANDOUT_BROWSER=
          for HANDOUT_BROWSER_NAME in google-chrome google-chrome-stable chromium chromium-browser; do
            if command -v "${HANDOUT_BROWSER_NAME}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              HANDOUT_BROWSER="$(command -v "${HANDOUT_BROWSER_NAME}")"
              break
            fi
          done
          [[ -n "${HANDOUT_BROWSER}" ]] || { echo "An installed Chrome/Chromium is required; no browser will be installed."; exit 1; }
          printf 'browser=%s\n' "${HANDOUT_BROWSER}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          "${HANDOUT_BROWSER}" --version
          command -v python3
          if command -v pdftotext >/dev/null 2>&1; then pdftotext -v; else echo "pdftotext unavailable; PDF artifacts require separate direct inspection."; fi
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4, inherited project pin
        with:
          node-version: ${{ steps.native.outputs.node }}
      - name: Install and identify the standard CJK print font
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install --yes --no-install-recommends fonts-noto-cjk
          dpkg-query -W -f='${binary:Package} ${Version}\n' fonts-noto-cjk
          command -v fc-match
          HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FAMILY="$(fc-match --format='%{family}\n' 'sans-serif:lang=ja')"
          HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE="$(fc-match --format='%{file}\n' 'sans-serif:lang=ja')"
          printf 'Japanese font family: %s\nJapanese font file: %s\n' "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FAMILY}" "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE}"
          [[ "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FAMILY}" == *"Noto Sans CJK JP"* ]]
          [[ -f "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE}" ]]
          dpkg-query -S -- "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE}"
          sha256sum -- "${HANDOUT_JP_FONT_FILE}"
      - name: Receive actual studio, file selection, separate downloads and print artifacts
        run: node tools/check_course_handout_browser.mjs --browser "${{ steps.native.outputs.browser }}" --output "${RUNNER_TEMP}/course-handout-receiving"
      - name: Verify the direct-open teacher page matches its modular sources
        run: python3 tools/make_handout.py --check
      - name: Preserve bounded original browser and print artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4, verified from the official tag
        with:
          name: course-handout-receiving-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/course-handout-receiving
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
          compression-level: 6

      - tools/build-offline-pack.py
      - tools/check_offline_pack_browser.mjs
      - courses/*.json
      - demo.html
      - .github/workflows/offline-pack-browser.yml

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  real-browser:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:

      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

name: test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  node-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      # Pinned to the live v4 tag tips (verified 2026-10-07).
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
      - name: run dependency-free unit/property tests
        run: node --test tests/*.test.mjs
      - name: verify demo.html is in sync with sources
        run: |
          cp demo.html /tmp/demo-before.html
          python3 tools/make_demo.py
          cmp /tmp/demo-before.html demo.html || { echo "demo.html is stale: run 'python3 tools/make_demo.py' and commit the result"; exit 1; }
